answer: Every agent identity parks a 40 euro deposit with a licensed custodian before it may move value. Each month 2 percent bleeds off, and honest traders must top it back up. When two accounts share a decision fingerprint, both deposits burn on the spot. Spinning up sixty clones costs 2400 euros upfront, plus the monthly bleed, plus the first flagged duplicate incinerating its pool. It runs like a wharf: the harbor master weighs the pulse of each barge engine and fines the ones that all chug in the same rhythm, so the nebula of cheap bots drifts in and settles in the mud.
